title: German Sprouts Strudel
description: A German-inspired pastry filled with sautéed sprouts and ratatouille, perfect for a savory breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Roll out the yeasty dough and spread the french butter evenly.
In a pan, sauté the sprouts and ratatouille over medium heat until tender.
Place the sautéed mixture on one half of the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Fold the other half of the dough over the filling and press edges to seal.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet and brush with remaining french butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, sprinkled with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: garnish with additional sprouts or ratatouille, if desired.
